name: Transaction Type 2
definition: Set of elements used to identify the transactions to be reported.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Specifies the status on the books of the account servicer of the transactions to be reported.

CreditDebitIndicator.name: Credit Debit Indicator
CreditDebitIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the reporting request refers to credit or debit entries.

FloorLimit.name: Floor Limit
FloorLimit.definition: Specifies the minimum value of entries to be reported in the requested message.
